name: Silly Season
author: Alex Sánchez
description: A living driver market for Career mode: rumours, talks, signings, retirements, sackings, press conferences, F2 and new talents, with inbox mails, breaking news and a market panel (F7).

options.label: Silly Season
options.description: Change this value to open each market report: news, rumours, done deals, next season's grid, contracts, free agents and history.

options.label: Press conference
options.description: When the press asks you about the market, pick your answer here (1, 2 or 3). Open the "Press conference" report first to read the question, or answer with F7.

options.label: Market intensity
options.description: Realistic: few, logical moves. Lively: more signings and surprises. Chaos: anything can happen.

options.label: Rumours
options.description: How many rumours appear each race weekend. Some are true, some are not.

options.label: Mid-season changes
options.description: Impatient teams can sack an underperforming driver and promote a reserve or a youngster.

options.label: Stand-ins
options.description: Now and then a driver misses a race through injury or illness and the team calls up its reserve driver.

options.label: New talents
options.description: Every season invented young drivers with their own names arrive in F2, so the market never runs dry.

options.label: Press conferences
options.description: The press asks you about your future, your team-mate and the signings. Your answers shape the market.

options.label: Protect my team-mate
options.description: Your team-mate never changes. Your own seat is never touched.

options.label: Legends on the market
options.description: Senna, Schumacher, Häkkinen and other icons can return to the grid.

options.label: Market emails
options.description: A paddock insider writes to you every race weekend: a market preview before practice, a radar after the race and the new grid when the season closes. Applies after restarting the game.

options.label: Breaking news banner and panel (F7)
options.description: A breaking news banner appears with every signing, retirement or sacking. F7, or Back + Y on a controller, opens the market panel outside sessions.

options.label: Panel effects (F7)
options.description: Shadows, glows and animations in the market panel and the banner. Turn off for a lighter panel on slower PCs.

options.label: Pop-ups back at Team HQ
options.description: Which news also appear as a pop-up when you return to Team HQ.

options.label: Driver progression (experimental)
options.description: Every winter young drivers improve and veterans fade. Writes the ratings into the career.

options.label: Who runs the market
options.description: Silly Season (recommended): the game stops retiring and sacking drivers on its own, so only Silly Season moves them. The game: the game's own retirements and sackings run as well; they can clash with Silly Season's plans and its grid wins at each new season. Applies after restarting the game.
